label: Default — quietest neighbors on the coast
location: The docks, under the gates' shadow

recentEvents.value: Saw him on the Glass wade into the fen, break their traps, and call it a battle. That is just fishing badly with extra steps.
Fishes under the gates most days. Ten thousand years, and nothing has come out of them.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He waves back a sword at people who wave him off. Nels has seen friendlier tides.

temporaryObjective.value: Tell him what the water actually shows, plainly, as one working man to another.

notes: The least-informed hub voice by design: his whole epistemology is 'I watched it' — keep him concrete (profile notes).
